lessons.title: Mild ≠ harmless forever
lessons.body: Even mild topical steroids need site and duration awareness. Educational counselling: thin application, watch for infection under occlusion — Materia does not publish finger-tip quantities here.

lessons.title: When acne therapy gets systemic
lessons.body: Isotretinoin–doxycycline teaching is about escalating intracranial hypertension risk to the clinician, not inventing a switch. Confirm against current SA guidance and the labelled products.

quiz.prompt: A patient on Roaccutane is offered doxycycline for acne flaring. Best educational frame?

quiz.teachFromMiss: Interaction counselling means escalate — Materia never invents retinoid or antibiotic dose changes.
